title: polypodium costatum
intro: Polypodium costatum, commonly known as the costum fern or Polypodium costatum, is a plant species belonging to the Polypodiaceae family. It has been traditionally used in medicine due to its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include treating conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues, as well as wound healing and skin irritation. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which have been isolated and studied for their potential medicinal applications.
